author: Jhayee
title: Looking for VTuber character designer / illustrator
content:
🔎 LOOKING FOR: VTUBER CHARACTER DESIGNER / ILLUSTRATOR

I’m looking for an artist who can take on an ORIGINAL CHARACTER COMMISSION for my VTuber character.

✨ Important: This is a character being designed from the ground up. I do not have an existing illustration, model, or character reference sheet for her yet. The purpose of this commission is to bring my character and her lore to life visually for the first time.

The design will be based primarily on:
• Her lore & backstory
• Detailed character descriptions
• Personality, themes & symbolism
• Written visual concepts
• References for specific features, materials, clothing, colors, etc. found online
The online images I provide would only be visual inspiration/reference for individual elements and are NOT references of an existing character to copy.

🎨 What I’m looking for:
• Original character design
• Full outfit & accessory design
• Hair, eyes, color palette, motifs, etc.
• Fantasy/lore-based design interpretation
• Full character sheet / reference sheet
• Front view + important design details
• Design notes where necessary

🌙 Preferred artistic direction:
Elegant, ethereal fantasy anime with a dreamy/celestial atmosphere, intricate details, magical elements, and a graceful, otherworldly feeling.
I’m especially interested in an artist who enjoys worldbuilding through character design and can take written lore and concepts and translate them into a cohesive visual identity.

💰 Budget: Budget is flexible
📅 Deadline: Hoping it can be finished this year

If interested, please comment or DM me with:
• Portfolio
• Commission rates
• Terms of Service
• Availability
• Estimated price for this type of project

I have extensive lore and character information prepared and can provide everything I currently have to help develop the design.
I’m looking for someone who can help me bring this original character to life for the very first time. ✨
RTs appreciated! 💜
#ArtistAlley #ArtCommission #VTuber #VTuberArtist #CharacterDesign #OriginalCharacter #OCCommission #VTuberDesign #CommissionOpen
